$comment: TUTORIAL deployment - a one-repo React landscape with a three-stage flow (analyze -> implement -> review). docs/TUTORIAL.md in the engine repo builds this project file by file; every key here is explained in docs/PACK.md §6. Structural keys (name/description/repos/mode) are consumed by setup; everything under `manifest` passes VERBATIM into the generated workspace manifest.json.
name: react-demo
description: Tutorial: analyze -> implement -> review flow for a single React SPA (fictional repo react-app)

repos.$comment: The REPO MAP. `known` lists every repo this deployment understands - artifacts may bind to these names, and a repos/<name>/ descriptor folder must match one. An additional `mandatory: [..]` list (not used here) would lock repos into every workspace of this deployment. react-app is FICTIONAL: create a stub folder next to your workspace to try the tutorial, or point the map at your own repo.

react-app.role: React 18 + Vite SPA - the product under work

flow.note: Values the flow skills read at run time. No tracker here - tasks arrive in chat; a real deployment would add flow.tracker (ticket patterns, label-to-repo routing - see docs/PACK.md §6.3).

runtimeTiers.note: Cost-ordered runtime ladder: pick the LOWEST tier that answers the question, climb only with a reason. The dev-server rung names its runbook by file name.

ladder.how: read the code - no runtime needed
Vite dev server, recipe in the runbook

modelTiers.note: The MODEL PROFILE: which model, effort and context width per harness, for which kind of work. sessionTier pins the ORCHESTRATOR session itself - it renders into each enabled harness's session config (.claude/settings.json model/effortLevel; .codex/config.toml model/model_reasoning_effort); agents pin their tier via frontmatter `model:` and the ladder maps the pin to each harness's value. rolePolicy documents which agent role sits on which tier - keep it in step with the frontmatter pins.

ladder.useWhen: mechanical work - file moves, catalog reads, formatting
bounded analysis over known structure - reading the task, mapping the change surface
writing and reviewing code; the SESSION default
